bodyText: Sentry | Error Tracking Software — JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, more Product Overview Custom Queries Dashboards Cross-project Issues Distributed Tracing Stack Traces Context Breadcrumbs Releases Issue Owners Platforms Security & Compliance Integrations Pricing Docs Blog Sign in Get started A developer sits at their desk in a high-rise apartment building, deploying production code. They reach over to tap their phone, checking if there are any error reports. The phone display signals that everything is OK. Out the window behind them, block by block the city lights flicker and go dark as a bug in their production code inexplicably takes down the city’s power grid. Will the citizens report the bug to them? If only they were using Sentry, they would already know. Stop hoping your users will report errors. We usually can't find enough data in real time from our other logging tools. With Sentry, we tag and filter our data so that we get a concise view of the problem and can fix a bug usually in under an hour.” Zhaobang Liu, DevOps Engineer “We get peace of mind from Sentry. In the case of a real issue, the number-one objective is to stop the bleeding.
